QUOTE: "`app/queries/servers/system.ts:304`: `archivedChannelsViewable = (value) => value !== 'false'`. Only an explicit `'false'` turns the feature off. Anything else, including `undefined`, means viewable."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that an absent setting means archived channels are viewable and only an explicit 'false' disables the feature.
